scope: Actual source text and saved model/mask/connectivity/coordinate/state data only. Prospective aligned-cell selection and set checks; no constructor, region measurement, force/tangent/HP/solve/consumer/test/render.

placement.initial_gap_basis: Body bottom y32 vs reference solid jaw top y30; body left x63 vs source vertical solid wall x60. This is coordinate inference, not a new boundary measurement or contact-onset test.
placement.identity: Body indices and fixed/free identity change although counts and original geometry/material masks stay the same. Must be a new task/model; prior27model SHA cannot be reused as this shifted model identity.

saved_tip.interpretation: The true reference far-right upper jaw tip is x80,y30, not x78,y30. At the old peak the edge2509->2510 rises through y32 while its x endpoints bracket the proposed right edge79. Extending the body to79 brings more of this rising tip-edge beneath/against the bottom-corner neighbourhood; tip2510 itself remains slightly outside x79 in the old state.
saved_tip.limitation: Old displacements are not translated/reused as a new equilibrium. Their intersection tendency only motivates placement; no new contact, gap, overlap or convergence result is asserted.

bottom_left_objectives: Keep bottom face y32 to target the upward moving far-right jaw neighbourhood. Moving left face63 away from wall60 increases initial left separation, helping isolate bottom/tip action. Right-side medium strip shrinks from2native cells to1, so boundary proximity and medium distortion deserve explicit attention.

source_rules.solid_lame: lambda_s and mu_s are proportional to E at fixednu
source_rules.regularization: kr=alpha*Lr^2*(kappa_s+4mu_s/3), global scalar and NOT multiplied by gamma

stiffness.uniform_scaling: If E->cE with gamma,alpha,nu,Lr,thickness and all kinematics unchanged, all material/Hu forces and tangents scale byc at a fixed displacement. With zero external/output/input springs and only an unknown average-input reaction, every ideal equilibrium(u,R) maps to(u,cR). Thus this mainly changes force scale and does not by itself promote geometric conformity; finite-arithmetic/domain and solution-branch behaviour still needs fresh qualification.
stiffness.ratio_caveat: Keeping only gamma/alpha ratio is insufficient to define a change. Holding both numerical values fixed gives uniform scaling. Co-scaling gamma and alpha can instead change the mechanism/medium contrast.
stiffness.genuine_relative_softening_existing_sche: An explicit later comparison E->cE,gamma->gamma/c,alpha->alpha/c keeps original medium Lamé coefficients and globalkr fixed while lowering solid Lamé coefficients. gamma/alpha ratio is unchanged, but gamma and alpha individually change. This can change deformation allocation near the rigid obstacle; it does not guarantee contact or a fitted jaw.
stiffness.caveat: kr is global, so preserving it while lowering solidE also increases regularization relative to solid stiffness. Alpha tunes Hu regularization, not a standalone calibrated physical contact stiffness or numerical tolerance. This remains a new physical parameter task requiring all original gates/fresh accepted-state reference.

recommendation: First execute one separately declared shifted-centre71 task with E1/gamma1e-6/alpha1e-6 and the complete original loading/return targets, so placement has an interpretable effect. Only then use one explicit relative-softening comparison if saved body force/gaps/J/Hu indicate that shaping remains needed; do not change geometry and stiffness together merely to obtain a pass.
